title: BLEACH REVEALS BLOOD CHAIN ICHIGO
dek: What Episode 45 confirms—and what remains theory.

scenes.headline: KUBO DESIGNED AND NAMED IT
scenes.body: Aniplex confirms Blood Chain Ichigo is new material drawn and named by BLEACH creator Tite Kubo.

scenes.headline: ICHIGO AWAKENS THE HOLLOW WITHIN
scenes.body: Episode 45's official synopsis says he enters partial Hollowfication against Yhwach.

scenes.headline: GETSUGA MEETS GRAN REY CERO
scenes.body: The anime fuses Ichigo's signature attack with one of the Arrancar side's most dangerous techniques.

scenes.headline: IS IT A NEW BANKAI? NOT OFFICIALLY CONFIRMED
scenes.body: The official announcement calls it a new form. The complete classification remains open.

scenes.headline: THE ANIME JUST EXPANDED THE ENDGAME
scenes.body: Blood Chain Ichigo turns Kubo's supervision into consequential new material at the center of the final fight.
